relevance_note: Case report plus literature review of HA20 caused by deletions of 6q involving TNFAIP3, with individual-level data for the neonate ('she was definitively diagnosed with HA20') and for the 11 previously published patients in Table 1.
method_note: Read only the paper, the schema and the rules; nothing was taken from memory. Table 1 was transcribed by hand from the Markdown (no script). The legend defines only two abbreviations ('Table notes: AIHA Autoimmune hemolytic anemia, HLH Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis'), so no cell symbol is defined as absent: '-' cells were therefore left not reported and '+' cells were read as present; 'Not mentioned' cells were left not reported. Cells of the 'Initial symptoms' row are merged multi-line values printed without separators (e.g. 'FeverRespiratory- infectionsGastroenteritis'); I read the words they contain as features of that one patient only and never assigned values positionally. No variant description is printed for any patient beyond the deletion size in the 'Size of deletion' row of Table 1, which is used as variant_original_string; no cDNA, protein, transcript, ACMG code, functional assay or per-person pathogenicity statement is printed (the Fig. 2 caption 'pathogenic deletions' is not tied to individuals, so pathogenicity is not reported). The Table 1 'Inheritance' row states 'de novo', 'paternal' or 'maternal' for individual patients but the paper never describes parental testing, so parental_testing_statement is not reported and inheritance was recorded from those cells. Patients 2-12 are the previously published patients reviewed in Table 1; their source column (author names) is copied into source_reference_in_review and no is_proband statement exists for them. For Patient 1, splenomegaly is reported at admission and later 'her spleen was not palpable' (a temporal change, both recorded); her normal ophthalmologic assessment, hearing test and brain MRI are recorded as the paper states them and were not used to exclude specific checklist items; her AIHA is explicitly said not to be in accordance with her, which is recorded as an exclusion of autoimmune cytopenia. No age at last evaluation is stated for any patient. The 'Inheritance' row of Table 1 gives a value per patient ('de novo', 'paternal', 'maternal', 'unknown'); I read it as the origin of that patient's deletion (paternal/maternal -> inherited paternal/inherited maternal) but, because the paper never describes parental testing, parental_testing_statement stays 'not reported' and 'unknown' stays 'not reported'. Two further reading choices: the 'Initial symptoms' cells 'Infections' (Patient 11) and 'Respiratory- infections' (Patient 4) do not state recurrence, so the checklist item 'recurrent infections' is left not reported for them although the printed words are kept in phenotypic_features; Patient 9's 'Henoch-Schönlein purpura' is recorded as a skin lesion (phenotypic_features) but 'vasculitis' is left not reported because the paper never calls it a vasculitis. Contradictions found in the paper: the Results say 'only 11 patients ... have been reported since 2016' while the same paragraph and the Discussion say 12 patients (the 12 include this report's patient); 'Age at diagnosis' is 'Not mentioned' for Patients 2 and 3 although their age of onset is given.
